snippet.title: The Falconeer Revolution Remaster | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Out NOW on Steam!

Take flight in this remastered aerial combat RPG. Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

This is a FREE Update for already existing owners of The Falconeer on Steam, as well as the now default version of The Falconeer available for sale.

It includes :
- Improved flight controls, animations and collisions.  
- Balances and changes to escort missions and those idle downtimes.
- A filled up world
- Edge of the World expansion content now included in the base game. 
- Additional new content, voice overs and much more.

Take flight today : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1135260/The_Falconeer/
